newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police hold suspected Basque guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: French police hold suspected Basque guerrillas.

text.p: Two women suspected of being members of a Basque separatist group were being held for questioning on Saturday in southwestern France, police said.
The women were detained as part of an investigation into the ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) conducted by Paris anti-terrorist judge Laurence Le Vert, they said.

Spanish officials say ETA may be turning to French targets because of the increased cooperation between Spain and France in the fight against the separatist group. Such cooperation has led to more than 200 arrests in the past decade.
ETA has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its violent campaign for an independent Basque state.
